title: The potato storage gamble
summary: Agra potatoes: ₹565 in March 2019, ₹850 in October. Break-even storage budget: ₹186 per quintal.
why_selected: Chosen automatically: the yearly harvest-to-autumn storage question at Agra, with 5 earlier seasons to learn from.

evidence.observations: monthly medians of Agra daily modal prices (≥8 reports)
caveats: No cold-storage rent is cited, so no net profit is claimed.
Stored and fresh potatoes may differ in grade.

scenes.headline: March 2019
scenes.caption: Potatoes are harvested in early spring and often held in cold stores in western Uttar Pradesh, which the RBI paper calls the potato belt's key selling point.

scenes.headline: Harvest price
scenes.caption: Agra's March 2019 median: ₹565 per quintal.

scenes.headline: The informed bet
scenes.caption: Using only the 5 earlier years, March→October had averaged +₹277. A rule-following trader would store.

scenes.headline: October 2019
scenes.caption: October median: ₹850, a change of +50.4%.

scenes.headline: Shrinkage and interest
scenes.caption: Allowing 7% loss and 12% a year interest for 7 months leaves a storage budget of ₹186 per quintal.

scenes.headline: The lesson
scenes.caption: Seven months of storage needed to cost less than ₹186 per quintal to break even. Cold-storage rents are not in our cited evidence, so AGRINET does not claim a profit.

assumptions.value: not in cited evidence; shown as break-even budget

conclusion: Seven months of storage needed to cost less than ₹186 per quintal to break even. Cold-storage rents are not in our cited evidence, so AGRINET does not claim a profit.

title: The month potato prices jumped across India
summary: In December 2019, the median potato market moved +19.1% in a month, 2.8 standard deviations from the usual for that month.
why_selected: Chosen automatically: the 2.8σ seasonal move is among the largest on record for potato, across 648 reporting markets.

evidence.observations: monthly medians of daily modal prices; markets need ≥5 reports in both months
caveats: Many market points are district centres, not mandi gates.
Modal prices are reported aggregates, not transaction offers.

scenes.headline: December 2019
scenes.caption: Potato prices across 648 markets that reported in both November 2019 and December 2019.

scenes.headline: Median move +19.1%
scenes.caption: The typical market's potato price jumped 19.1% in one month. 82% of markets moved the same way.

scenes.headline: 2.8× the usual swing
scenes.caption: Compared with the same month in every earlier year on record, this move was 2.8 standard deviations from normal.

scenes.headline: Punjab
scenes.caption: Neighbouring markets moved together: the 75 reporting markets in Punjab had a median change of +45.5%.

scenes.headline: Dhand
scenes.caption: Dhand (Haryana), one of the busiest markets among the biggest movers: monthly median ₹1,400 → ₹2,250 per quintal (+60.7%).

scenes.headline: What this does and doesn't show
scenes.caption: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.

conclusion: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.
